# IVO Evidence 0.1.1
## New Features
- Automatic update checks and signed Sparkle update support through GitHub Releases. - A What's New summary that appears once for each installed app version. - Release notes grouped into New Features, Bug Fixes, and General Improvements.
## Bug Fixes
- Stabilised the complete Swift Testing gate for file-heavy evidence tests. - Hardened beta archive metadata handling for strict macOS signature verification.
## General Improvements
- Established beta semantic versioning from 0.1.1 toward the 1.0 release. - Added repeatable GitHub release, appcast, build-number, and update-signing tooling.
